sections.text: About Us

Creation.

Let’s Get Lost was founded by Alicia Casillas Ramos and Anthony Ball, a husband-and-wife team united by a shared calling: to guide others back into their bodies, where true healing begins.

What started as a sanctuary in Ubud, Bali has grown into a living vision of somatic wisdom, one that will soon extend to the wild landscapes of southern Spain. Rooted in years of deep practice in breathwork, trauma-informed facilitation, Reiki, men’s work, and holistic embodiment, Alicia and Anthony created Let’s Get Lost not just as a retreat space, but as an academy for embodied transformation.

Here, science meets spirit. The nervous system is honoured. Presence is non-negotiable. And healing is understood as a full-body experience, not just a mental exercise.

At the heart of their work is a simple truth:

The body holds the stories the mind cannot explain and through it, we can heal what words cannot reach.

Their trainings, ranging from 100-hour Breathwork Instructor Certifications to Reiki Teacher Programs and Men’s Embodiment Circles, are designed for those ready to step into service with depth, integrity, and skill. Whether you’re a therapist, coach, yoga teacher, or simply someone feeling the quiet pull toward deeper work, Let’s Get Lost offers more than techniques. It offers a way of being, one that empowers you to hold space for others while staying grounded in your own truth.

This is not just education. It’s initiation.
And you’re welcome here, whether you find us in Bali, Spain, or online.

Everything we do at Let’s Get Lost flows from a set of guiding principles, values that shape how we teach, how we hold space, and how we show up in our own lives. These aren’t just words on a page; they’re lived commitments woven into every training, session, and human connection we make.

Embodiment
We teach from the body, not just the mind. True healing begins when we move beyond concepts and into felt experience. For us, embodiment isn’t a technique, it’s a way of being.

Safety First
Transformation can only unfold in safety. We cultivate spaces that are psychologically, emotionally, and somatically secure, where people feel seen, respected, and free to move at their own pace.

Integrity
We share only what we live. Our facilitators are lifelong students of their own growth, committed to walking the path they invite others to explore.

Presence Over Performance
Healing isn’t about dramatic breakthroughs, it’s about showing up, again and again, with honesty and attention. We honour the quiet, sacred unfolding of each person’s journey.

Accessibility & Inclusion
Healing is a human right, not a privilege. We’re dedicated to making our work trauma-informed, inclusive, and accessible, so that more people, from more walks of life, can find the tools they need to thrive.

Community & Connection
We heal in relationship, with ourselves, with each other, and with the living world around us. Our trainings are designed to nurture belonging, authentic connection, and collective growth.

Our Values.

Our Purpose.

We exist to reconnect people with the innate intelligence of the body, the quiet, wise guide that knows how to heal, regulate, and restore.

In a world that often values thinking over feeling, speed over stillness, and fixing over listening, we offer a different path: one that returns us to the body as a source of truth, safety, and deep transformation.

We train practitioners who understand that lasting change doesn’t come from bypassing pain, forcing outcomes, or intellectualizing healing, but from feeling deeply, listening closely, and integrating fully.

Our work is rooted in three core truths:

The body holds what the mind cannot process.

Trauma unwinds through presence, not pressure.

Healing begins when we learn to feel, not when we try to “figure it out.”

Through experiential education, trauma-informed guidance, and intentional community, we equip students with more than techniques, we offer a way home. Home to the breath. Home to the body. Home to a life lived with presence, resilience, and full aliveness.

This isn’t just professional training.
It’s a return to wholeness.

How Stress Can Cause Disease

Chronic stress, while often seen as a normal part of modern life, can have serious and long-lasting effects on the body, contributing to the development of various diseases. When stress becomes chronic, it triggers a cascade of biological responses that can disrupt the body's balance, weakening its ability to fight disease.

Relaxation Through Breathwork

Stress is ever-present, but simple breathwork techniques can be an effective way to manage it. By using diaphragmatic breathing, box breathing, and alternate-nostril breathing, we can directly activate the parasympathetic nervous system (PNS); the body’s natural mechanism for relaxation. Let’s explore how these techniques promote relaxation and counter the effects of stress. (Check out our other blog how stress can cause disease)

Who is this course for?

This course is for students looking to dive deeper into the aspects of breathwork and themselves, understand the art of teaching, and for those wanting to guide a breathwork session in both 1 on 1 and a group format. Whether you are a complete beginner looking to explore the potential of breathwork for yourself or looking to become an instructor and build your own breathwork practice, this training is for you. You will learn multiple different styles of breathwork along with other techniques that combine great with Breathwork so you have a vast knowledge base to use once you have completed your training.

Want help to manage stress & anxiety for yourself or others? Are you going through a transition period in your life and looking for a practice to assist you? Maybe you want to gain more clarity in your life with your purpose and direction. Breathwork is an amazing tool to help regulate our body’s nervous system while also bringing us to stillness to guide us with clearer visions and release past emotions and energetic blocks.

Breathwork has many aspects and differs for everyone and at each point in our lives, making it a lifelong teacher.

Breathwork can be; healing, meditative, releasing, energizing, relaxing, transformative, and much more. It will always offer you what you are ready for in the moment and when you are ready the answers will come.

Meet Your Experts

Anthony Ball

Lead Teacher

On my journey of self-discovery, I found Breathwork and meditation as the practice that helped me find balance and grounding. I specialize in embodiment, coming out of the thinking mind, and connecting with intuition and the emotional body.

I offer the space to reconnect to the body and soul by using embodiment practices including shamanic, breathwork, and Osho. I have spent many years in the world of health, wellness, and coaching, creating successful travel, adventure, and hotel businesses in the UK & Bali.

Using breathwork and other powerful techniques I have seen huge shifts within my students. I am dedicated to guiding others to discover peace within and have the confidence, clarity, and motivation to achieve their calling in life.

Youtube channels:

Breathwork: https://www.youtube.com/@Anthonybreathes

Mens Work: https://www.youtube.com/@workingonitpod

Alicia Casillas

Pranayama Teacher

I support conscious humans in uncovering their inner voice, giving them the tools to align their lives, and lighting up the way to their most authentic selves.

My life didn’t always look like this. In fact, it used to look a lot different.

After a serious physical injury from years of strenuous exercise, I began searching for a more gentle way to keep active that had a lower impact on my body. My sports psychologist had previously suggested trying meditation to help deal with the pressure that came hand in hand with competitive swimming, and I figured, why not give it a go?

Shortly after being introduced to meditation, I discovered yoga and it didn’t take long until I was hooked. Once I began to experience the dramatic impact these practices had on my body, my mind, and my overall well-being, well, there was no turning back.

After graduating from university, I booked myself a one-way ticket to Asia and embarked on an adventure of a lifetime. I dove headfirst into a new way of life (I was a swimmer at heart after all), and immersed myself fully into yoga and spirituality, learning as much as I possibly could through retreats, workshops, studies, and of course a daily devotional practice. Soon, I discovered that nurturing my mind, my heart, and my body were all key elements to embodying a soul-filled life.

Dr Brendan

Mental Health Expert

Dr. Brendan is a psychiatrist and health entrepreneur with a passion for holistic mental health and personal optimization. With a background in traditional psychiatry, Dr. Brendan has expanded into non-conventional approaches to mental wellness, integrating cutting-edge mental health strategies with mindfulness, breathwork, and holistic practices. In this talk, Dr. Brendan will explore the intersection of mental health and breathwork, offering insights on how to unlock personal empowerment, practice safely and understand how to work with people with mental health conditions.

Andrea Abian

Anatomy Teacher

Andrea is a Physiotherapist and Yoga Therapist, also a dedicated ashtanga yoga practitioner. With over 15 years of experience as a physiotherapist, she is an expert in pain treatment, structural realignment, and case resolution.

She is also specialized in therapeutic massage, fascia release, and dry needling while doing customized pain treatments, combining various techniques such as Foot Reflexology and neuromuscular bandage (Kinesiotaping).

Andrea studies Yoga Therapy with the Master Sharat Arora, A.G Mohan (Krishnamacharya disciple),  and Viniyoga with Tirumalai Krishnamacharya. Andrea combines her passion for Physiotherapy, Yoga Therapy, and Yin with her vocation for teaching and sharing the sacred tradition of Yoga.

sections.text: Our Teachers

Anthony Ball

On my journey of self-discovery, I found Breathwork and meditation as the practice that helped me find balance and grounding. I specialize in embodiment, coming out of the thinking mind, and connecting with intuition and the emotional body.

I offer the space to reconnect to the body and soul by using embodiment practices including shamanic, breathwork, and Osho. I have spent many years in the world of health, wellness, and coaching, creating successful travel, adventure, and hotel businesses in the UK & Bali.

Using breathwork and other powerful techniques I have seen huge shifts within my students. I am dedicated to guiding others to discover peace within and have the confidence, clarity, and motivation to achieve their calling in life.

Youtube channels:

Breathwork: https://www.youtube.com/@Anthonybreathes

Mens Work: https://www.youtube.com/@workingonitpod

Alicia Casillas

I support conscious humans in uncovering their inner voice, giving them the tools to align their lives, and lighting up the way to their most authentic selves.

My life didn’t always look like this. In fact, it used to look a lot different.

After a serious physical injury from years of strenuous exercise, I began searching for a more gentle way to keep active that had a lower impact on my body. My sports psychologist had previously suggested trying meditation to help deal with the pressure that came hand in hand with competitive swimming, and I figured, why not give it a go?

Shortly after being introduced to meditation, I discovered yoga and it didn’t take long until I was hooked. Once I began to experience the dramatic impact these practices had on my body, my mind, and my overall well-being, well, there was no turning back.

After graduating from university, I booked myself a one-way ticket to Asia and embarked on an adventure of a lifetime. I dove headfirst into a new way of life (I was a swimmer at heart after all), and immersed myself fully into yoga and spirituality, learning as much as I possibly could through retreats, workshops, studies, and of course a daily devotional practice. Soon, I discovered that nurturing my mind, my heart, and my body were all key elements to embodying a soul-filled life.

Rena

My name is Rena. I grew up in West Java, Indonesia, where music lives in the air and healing happens in the community. For a long time, I survived. I imagine you know that feeling too.

The shift came through breath. A single, deliberate inhale that reminded me there was more space inside me than I had been allowing. And when the sound of Indonesian instruments held that breath, something deeper opened. A remembering. A return.

What you can expect:

Every session is a guided breathwork journey, a space to slow down and return to yourself. Some are held in stillness, some with music, and some woven with the live sounds of Indonesian instruments like gamelan and angklung.

Whatever the container, you are welcome as you are.

This work is my commitment to my people in Indonesia, and to every human being worldwide who is ready to start becoming.

You are ready. Let’s breathe.

sections.text: Our Philosophy

A Centre for Connection

At Let’s Get Lost, we believe that healing doesn’t happen in isolation, it unfolds in relationship: with ourselves, with each other, and with the living Earth.

We offer more than workshops, trainings, or retreats. We offer a return to what matters: presence, authenticity, and the quiet truth of the body. In a world that constantly asks us to do more, be more, and prove our worth, we hold a different space, one where you are already whole. Already enough.

Here, there’s no need to fix yourself. Only to feel, listen, and reconnect.

Our work supports both the inner journey, calming the mind, awakening the body, integrating past wounds, and the outer expression of that healing through genuine community. We bring people together not to escape life, but to re-engage with it more fully, supported by others who understand the weight and beauty of being human.

Eco-Friendly by Design

Sustainability isn’t an add-on at Let’s Get Lost, it’s the foundation.

Built on leased land stewarded by a Balinese family for generations, our centre runs in harmony with nature. We are semi off-grid, powered by sun, wind, and rain. Rainwater nourishes our gardens; filtered well water sustains us; greywater flows through natural reed beds before returning to our ponds.

Every material was chosen with care, recycled, repurposed, and designed to be returned to the Earth if ever deconstructed. Our buildings breathe with the jungle, not against it.

When you step onto this land, you’re not just visiting a retreat, you’re entering a living example of what’s possible when humans choose to thrive with nature, not at its expense.

Rooted in Community

We believe in supporting locals, with locals, for locals.

From the very beginning, Let’s Get Lost has been built with Bali, not just in it. Local contractors shaped our space. Local healers guide our Reiki, yoga, and meditation sessions. And the land itself is held in trust with deep respect for the family who has cared for it for generations.

This isn’t tourism. It’s reciprocity.

By centering Balinese knowledge, craftsmanship, and wisdom, we honour the culture that hosts us, and ensure that our presence contributes meaningfully to the community around us.

Founded with Purpose

Let’s Get Lost was born from a personal transformation.

After years of burnout and disconnection, founder Anthony “Ant” Ball, a British entrepreneur, outdoor adventurer, and breathwork facilitator—found his way back through men’s circles, somatic practice, and the healing power of breath. That experience became a calling: to create a space where others, especially men, could access the same depth of healing without having to hit rock bottom first.

In 2020, after five years of falling in love with Bali’s spirit and landscape, Ant began building Let’s Get Lost in Ubud, not as a business, but as an offering. A sanctuary. A home for those ready to stop performing—and start feeling.

Today, that vision is expanding to southern Spain, but the heart remains the same: a place to come home to your body, your truth, and your people.

Meet the Teacher

Alicia Casillas

I support conscious humans in uncovering their inner voice, giving them the tools to align their lives, and lighting up the way to their most authentic selves.

My life didn’t always look like this. In fact, it used to look a lot different.

After a serious physical injury from years of strenuous exercise, I began searching for a more gentle way to keep active that had a lower impact on my body. My sports psychologist had previously suggested trying meditation to help deal with the pressure that came hand in hand with competitive swimming, and I figured, why not give it a go?

Shortly after being introduced to meditation, I discovered yoga and it didn’t take long until I was hooked. Once I began to experience the dramatic impact these practices had on my body, my mind, and my overall well-being, well, there was no turning back.

After graduating from university, I booked myself a one-way ticket to Asia and embarked on an adventure of a lifetime. I dove headfirst into a new way of life (I was a swimmer at heart after all), and immersed myself fully into yoga and spirituality, learning as much as I possibly could through retreats, workshops, studies, and of course a daily devotional practice. Soon, I discovered that nurturing my mind, my heart, and my body were all key elements to embodying a soul-filled life.

sections.text:
Booking Let’s Get Lost as a Retreat Leader / Facilitator

Please note as we receive many inquiries and requests for reservations, all bookings are on a first come first serve basis.

Bookings are only confirmed when a downpayment is received.

A 3-6 part payment plan is worked out when booking Let’s Get Lost for your own retreat, training or workshop.

We suggest covering all meals, massages, other expenses factored for your guests on your final downpayment. If you decide to pay these expenses on arrival, then please note we accept CASH ONLY in major currencies.

Payment must arrive in the bank anytime before payment due date which will be highlighted in your invoice.

An additional 40$ USD is required to be added ontop of each transfer to cover international bank transfer / sender fees.

Any missing amount will be highlighted on your invoice-receipt to be settled in cash upon check in at Let’s Get Lost.

Invoice is valid for 7 days from date of issue

The booking is then released after 7 days for other inquiries, if payment hasn't been arranged.

Temporary Work Permit

A temporary work permit at Let’s Get Lost gives you peace of mind for the duration of your retreat. The work permit fee will be added to your invoice and next steps highlighted upon inquiry and prior to booking with us.

Cancellation or Postponing as a Group Retreat Leader / Facilitator

No refunds or reimbursements are made under any life circumstances or emergency situations or force majeure [including Covid-19] when cancelling your retreat.

If a retreat leader decides to postpone their own retreat, it must be given in writing by email and Let’s Get Lost will then offer options as per the postponement fee highlighted below.

Postponement Fee

If a retreat leader decides to postpone their retreat to the next 6-months, the postponement fee applied will be 10% from the total rental fee on invoice. Tax and service will not be charged in the postponement fee.

If a retreat leader decides to postpone their retreat to the next 12-months, the postponement fee applied will be 20% from the total rental fee on invoice. Tax and service will not be charged in the postponement fee.

Due to Covid-19 / Any Force Majeure Incident

If a retreat leader has not paid a postponement fee and Bali's airport is closed for international flights 1 month prior to the original retreat date, then Let’s Get Lost will offer a 6-month window to postpone the retreat at no penalty.

If a retreat leader has paid a postponement fee and Bali's airport is closed for international flights 1 month prior to the original retreat date, then Let’s Get Lost will apply your postponement fee towards your retreat meal budget and a 6-month window will be offered to postpone at no penalty. A fee will apply if retreat leader wishes to postpone to a longer 12-window (20% as shared above under postponement fee)

If a retreat leader has paid a postponement fee and Bali's airport is open for International flights 1 month prior to the retreat, then the fee is non-refundable / non-transferable. Let’s Get Lost will retain the postponement fee towards operational expenses.

Why do we have such a strict policy?

Our center is a highly sought after, sacred space. All retreat leaders (host) and guests leave with an added sense of who they are and their mission. When a host books a retreat at our center, we reserve those dates and turn away all other hosts looking to book in that time frame. Any cancellations create an imbalance in the flow of energy at our center. Our goal is to utilize our center to its fullest capacity and activate as many people as we can.

-------

Booking & Cancellation as a guest

Please note as we receive many inquiries and requests for reservations, all bookings are on a first come first serve basis.

Bookings are only confirmed when a downpayment is received.

No refunds or reimbursements are made when cancelling a Detox or TM Retreat, under any life circumstances or emergency situations or force majeure [including Covid-19].

We do not offer credit for arriving late or leaving early. There are no partial refunds for any services not used while the retreat is going.

If you are booking six months in advance, a 50% non-refundable deposit may be transferred and the remaining 50% balance of your payment is due one month prior to your retreat start date.

If you are booking within six months leading up to your retreat, full 100% payment is required.

An additional 40 USD will be added onto your invoice to cover international bank transfer / sender fees - per transfer.

Any missing amount will be highlighted on your invoice-receipt to be settled in cash or credit card upon check in at Let’s Get Lost.

Invoice / Booking is valid for 3 days from date of issue.

The booking is then released after 3 days for other inquiries, if payment hasn't been arranged.

Check-in & Check out timings

Check-in time is at 2:00 PM and check out time is at 12:00 PM for all bookings.

Any early arrivals or late departure times are subject to the availability of the villa.

Complimentary Pick up & Drop off from Airport

A minimum of 3 nights must be booked to avail a complimentary pickup and drop-off (transfers both ways).

Alternatively, a 300,000 IDR applies per transfer from Airport to Let’s Get Lost and vice versa.

Transfers included in ALL retreats are strictly from Point A (Airport or Hotel) to Point B (Let’s Get Lost) - and vice versa. We do not offer a complimentary shuttle service from Point A to another destination.

Utilities

Windows and bedroom doors must be closed while air-conditioning is in use. Let’s Get Lost abides with an eco-friendly policy. Therefore, we request that lights & other electric items must be switched off when you need to go out or stay long outside of the villa. Villa staff may comply with this policy.

Cancellation Policy, Risks and Insurance

Facilitators and all guests must assume complete and full responsibility for and hereby release Let’s Get Lost, the owner/s, the employees or anyone involved in supplying any services during the length of the proposed travel and retreat booking.

Let’s Get Lost shall not be responsible for any injuries, losses or damages in connection with accommodations, other facilities at the resort, ground transportation, diseases, Acts of God, local laws, climatic condition delays, changes or cancellation of travel due to weather conditions, accidents or health related problems while residing at Let’s Get Lost, and while in-transit to (e.g., an accident on the way to a tour or into town etc), during and after a tour.

In case of force majeure [applies to Covid-19], act of governing law, climatic condition disruption which forces airport closure or travel bans / restrictions, your full payment will be credited to another date within 6 months from date of original booking. Please see above.

It is the traveler’s responsibility to obtain appropriate insurance coverage against these risks.  You can purchase Travel Insurance when you purchase your airline ticket with most airlines and travel agents.

If travel plans are delayed or cancelled for any reason there will be no refunds issued by Let’s Get Lost, except as stated above.

We specifically recommend that foreigners entering Indonesia do so with a valid Passport expiring more than six month following the departure date from Indonesia.

Let’s Get Lost is not responsible for expenses incurred in preparation for any cancelled trips by a guest such as flight cancellation or illness, airline tickets complications or for costs incurred due to travel delays.

Join us in Ubud, Bali for a 65-Hour Somatic Yin Yoga Teacher Training created for those who feel called to slow down, reconnect with the body, and learn how to guide others into deep rest and gentle awareness.

Held at The In Movement Studio, this Yoga Alliance Continuing Education training brings together Yin Yoga, somatic practices, breathwork, meditation, fascia education, and energetic awareness in a supportive and nurturing learning environment.

This training offers both a professional certification and a meaningful personal journey.

About the Training

Yin Yoga invites us to move at a quieter pace and develop a more compassionate relationship with the body. Through long-held postures and mindful attention, the practice can support nervous system balance, emotional wellbeing, and healthy mobility of the joints and connective tissue.

This training approaches Yin Yoga through a somatic and energetic lens, helping you understand how the practice supports both physical and subtle layers of experience. You will learn how to create Yin Yoga classes that feel safe, accessible, and deeply restorative for a wide range of students.

What You Will Learn

Yin Yoga Foundations

• Yin Yoga philosophy and principles

• Functional anatomy and fascia basics

• Yin–Yang balance in practice and daily life

• Gentle and supportive use of props

Somatics & Nervous System Support

• Embodied awareness and interoception

• Trauma-aware language and space holding

• Practices that support relaxation and stress release

Energetics of Yin Yoga

• Introduction to subtle body awareness

• Breath, attention, and energy flow

• Meditation and self-regulation practices

Teaching Methodology

• Sequencing Yin Yoga classes with care

• Clear and compassionate cueing

• Teaching with confidence and authenticity

Who This Training Is For

This training is open to:

• Yoga teachers wishing to offer Yin Yoga

• Students who want to deepen their practice

• Wellness practitioners exploring somatic approaches

• Anyone longing for rest, balance, and reconnection

No advanced experience is required, only curiosity and openness.

About Your Teachers

Alicia Casillas

Yin Yoga Lead Teacher

Alicia was born in Spain and became a professional athlete at the age of fourteen years old. She began her yoga journey when she moved to the United States to earn her Bachelor's Degree at the University of Miami. Alicia first turned to Yoga to recover from a severe physical injury she acquired as a professional swimmer. Through Yoga, she discovered how to connect and balance her mind, body, and soul.

She has practiced and taught around North America, Europe, and Asia for more than ten years. She is an experienced yoga teacher E-RYT 500, and a Continuing Education Provider by Yoga Alliance who has been teaching Yoga Teacher Trainings since 2015 in Thailand. She trained in various lineages and schools in Thailand, India, Indonesia, Spain, and the USA; Ashtanga Vinyasa, Hatha Yoga, Akhanda Yoga, Vikasa Yoga, and Yin Yoga. Alicia has completed over 500 hours of Yin Yoga training with Yin Yoga Master Sarah Powers, Tina Nance, and Jamie Clarke (teaching assistant of Paul Grilley). She has also attended several anatomy and physiology training and workshops in different healing modalities.

Alicia is also trained as Reiki Master and Craniosacral Therapist under Upledger Institute, allowing her a better understanding of the wholeness of our being. Her holistic approach allows her to work with the student as a whole, listening to every part of the being. Yoga enables Alicia to share methods, tools, and techniques to help one achieve a healthy, mindful and happy way of life.

Andrea Abian

Anatomy Teacher

Andrea is a Physiotherapist and Yoga Therapist, also a dedicated ashtanga yoga practitioner. With over 15 years of experience as a physiotherapist, she is an expert in pain treatment, structural realignment, and case resolution.

She is also specialized in therapeutic massage, fascia release, and dry needling while doing customized pain treatments, combining various techniques such as Foot Reflexology and neuromuscular bandage (Kinesiotaping).

Andrea studies Yoga Therapy with the Master Sharat Arora, A.G Mohan (Krishnamacharya disciple),  and Viniyoga with Tirumalai Krishnamacharya. Andrea combines her passion for Physiotherapy, Yoga Therapy, and Yin with her vocation for teaching and sharing the sacred tradition of Yoga.
